title: An order, made explicit
lede: Explore ownership, cardinality, and specialization in a small commerce model.

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.detail: A person who places orders. This model allows a customer with no orders.

nodes.label: Order
nodes.detail: Owns its line items; payment is modeled separately.

nodes.label: LineItem
nodes.detail: A snapshot of a purchased item. Owned by exactly one order.

nodes.label: Payment
nodes.detail: Base payment record. Zero or one payment is associated with an order in this simplified model.

nodes.label: CardPayment
nodes.detail: A specialized Payment handled through an external processor. No card secrets are modeled.

edges.label: places
edges.detail: One customer can place zero or more orders; an order belongs to one customer.

edges.label: contains
edges.detail: The filled diamond at Order denotes ownership. Each order has one or more line items.

edges.label: paid by
edges.detail: An order can be unpaid. This example permits at most one payment record.

edges.label: specializes
edges.detail: The hollow triangle points to Payment, the general type. CardPayment specializes that type.

steps.title: A customer places orders
steps.body: Read cardinality at each end: one customer for an order, and zero or more orders for a customer.

steps.title: Line items belong to the order
steps.body: Composition expresses ownership. The filled diamond sits at the whole, Order.

steps.title: Payment can be absent
steps.body: An order is associated with zero or one payment. The model does not pretend all orders are paid.

steps.title: A card payment is a payment
steps.body: Generalization points from the specialized class to its parent. The walkthrough reveals structure; it is not object execution.

assumptions: Illustrative domain model; not generated from a production schema.
One payment per order and owned line-item snapshots are deliberate simplifications; retries, refunds and split payments require a richer model.
UML subset: class compartments, association, composition and generalization. “+” is public and “−” is private visibility.
evidence: Evidence: illustrative example; no application repository was supplied.
